1.t: What are they asking one another about

4.t: But no! They will come to know

5.t: Again, no! They will come to know

6.t: Have We not smoothed out the earth ˹like a bed˺

9.t: and made your sleep for rest

10.t: and made the night as a cover

11.t: and made the day for livelihood

12.t: and built above you seven mighty ˹heavens˺

13.t: and placed ˹in them˺ a shining lamp

14.t: and sent down from rainclouds pouring water

15.t: producing by it grain and ˹various˺ plants

17.t: Indeed, the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision is an appointed time—

18.t: ˹it is˺ the Day the Trumpet will be blown, and you will ˹all˺ come forth in crowds
18.tr: Yauma yun-fakhu fis soori fataa-toona afwaaja

19.t: The sky will be ˹split˺ open, becoming ˹many˺ gates

20.t: and the mountains will be blown away, becoming ˹like˺ a mirage

21.t: Indeed, Hell is lying in ambush

22.t: as a home for the transgressors

23.t: where they will remain for ˹endless˺ ages

24.t: There they will not taste any coolness or drink
24.tr: Laa ya-zooqoona feeha bar-daw walaa sharaaba

27.t: For they never expected any reckoning

29.t: And We have everything recorded precisely

30.t: ˹So the deniers will be told,˺ “Taste ˹the punishment˺, for all you will get from Us is more torment.”

31.t: Indeed, the righteous will have salvation—

33.t: and full-bosomed maidens of equal age

35.t: never to hear any idle talk or lying therein—
35.tr: Laa yasma'oona fiha lagh-waw walaa kizzaba

36.t: a ˹fitting˺ reward as a generous gift from your Lord

37.t: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, the Most Compassionate. No one will dare speak to Him
37.tr: Rabbis samaa-waati wal-ardi Wa-maa baina-humar rahmaani laa yam-likoona minhu khitaaba

38.t: on the Day the ˹holy˺ spirit and the angels will stand in ranks. None will talk, except those granted permission by the Most Compassionate and whose words are true
38.tr: Yauma yaqoo-mur roohu wal-malaa-ikatu saf-fal laa yatakallamoona ill-laa man azina lahur rahmaanu Wa-qaala sawaaba

39.t: That Day is the ˹ultimate˺ truth. So let whoever wills take the path leading back to their Lord
39.tr: Zaalikal yaumul haqqu faman shaa-at ta-khaaza ill-laa rabbihi ma-aaba

40.t: Indeed, We have warned you of an imminent punishment—the Day every person will see ˹the consequences of˺ what their hands have done, and the disbelievers will cry, “I wish I were dust.”
40.tr: In-naa anzar-naakum azaaban qareebaiy yauma yan-zurul marr-u maa qaddamat yadaahu Wa-ya-qoolul kaafiru yaa-lai-tanee kuntu turaaba
